label: Makassar
short_description: South Sulawesi's port capital, the gateway to Toraja and eastern Indonesia.
intro: Makassar is South Sulawesi's provincial capital and the main gateway to eastern Indonesia, a port city built around the Losari Beach waterfront and the Dutch-era Fort Rotterdam. Hotels here skew business and transit-oriented -- travelers connecting onward to the Toraja highlands, Bunaken, or Raja Ampat commonly overnight in the city -- and are reached via Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport (UPG), about 30 minutes from the city center.
